name: Rebuilt document-text retrieval under financial presentation changes
status: Exploratory engineering follow-up; no external preregistration or fresh holdout
unit_neutral: Mask monetary row values and normalize monetary scale tokens in the BM25 index and query only. Keep raw chunks for the reader; retain periods, labels, entities, shares and per-share values.
exploration_disclosure: Native-view 400-outcome run was inspected before adding the unit-neutral view and original-ranking diagnostic. Native structure test accuracy was 30/35 original and 14/35 rescaled. This is hypothesis development on reused data, not confirmatory evidence.
prepublication_correction: Review of the first 800-outcome draft found that a broad shares-label rule misclassified monetary equity rows and some share-count rows. Narrow count-row recognition and explicit thousands overrides corrected the preparation; all conditions were rerun. Earlier exploratory numbers above describe the development history, not the final results.
frozen_ranking_reference: Answer from transformed chunks at original top-5 chunk identities; compare with rerun retrieval to diagnose ranking-induced changes. No annotated source page is injected.
retrieval: Unfiltered BM25 across all issuers; fresh index for every variant and chunker
reader: Question-resolved symbolic selection with exact Decimal unit conversion and conflict refusal
data: 50 existing numeric questions, 1275 locked parsed pages, existing statement table fixtures
preparation: Replace every page represented in statement-tables.jsonl with all its reconstructed statement tables; retain other pages. No queried metric or gold value selects rows or pages.
intervention_boundary: Rendered table text before chunking, index construction, retrieval and answer-time cell parsing
reporting: Publish both chunkers, all variants and every failure separately by development/test split; no selection and no significance claim
limits: Statement reconstruction still depends on prior table extraction; no general PDF or OCR claim
Affected statement pages lose surrounding prose; results are not directly comparable with the original LLM pilot
BM25 only; no dense retrieval or learned reranker claim
Other pages are unchanged, including duplicate narrative disclosures; no evidence-removal experiment is claimed
Reused issuer split and five metric families; no new independent questions or human adjudication
Symbolic reader is a restricted baseline, not a stronger LLM result
